name: Inami Kaede
source:
Her looks may deceive you, but despite her flat chest and her childlike face, she's the mother of Shuu and Maho. Her kind smile has a healing effect on many people. She's mostly strict and firm, however she can also be quite easygoing, spoiling her son and daughter. It seems like she usually goes to sleep at 9 PM, and her hobby is kitchen gardening. 
Because she looks young she enrolled in the same school the main characters attend, even more, she is in the same group as Shuu.

「My baby's babys…… I want to give birth to a lot of them～♪」
